facts.business: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing integrated services across the drug development lifecycle, including process R&D, late-stage clinical and commercial manufacturing, and supply of APIs and intermediates.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on accounting treatment of merger goodwill (Note 28) and deviation in standalone financial covenants for debentures (Note 37); waivers requested/partially received.

key_risks: Deviation in standalone financial covenants for listed non-convertible debentures
Goodwill impairment risk (₹594.17 Cr carrying value, amortized over 99 years)
Regulatory compliance risk (EDQM observations for Bavla site historically)
Contingent liabilities including disputed tax demands (Income tax ₹374.95 Cr, Excise/GST ₹31.23 Cr)
